answer: Use rotating escrow bonds with independent replay audits. 1) Each fresh key locks 70 POA for 30 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 70,000 POA, risks 35,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. Like a delta channel cutting through basalt and shale, one worker leaves a traceable course; aliases cannot widen it.
